current_detections.name: Bullish Flag
current_detections.evidence: Strong impulsive rally from approximately 58000 to 61000 followed by slight downward/sideways consolidation near 60000-60500, forming a flag pattern after the impulse pole.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Breakout above flag resistance (trigger level) to confirm continuation; clear definition of flag trendlines.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke above prior swing high resistance near 59000 after establishing a higher low at 56000, shifting market structure from bearish to bullish.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Successful retest of broken structure as support to validate bullish continuation
